correctness.rationale: Invert the almost-surely nonsingular 2-by-2 Gaussian Gram to derive an exact lower triangular compressed matrix and eigenvector ratio. Haar invariance of the 2-by-3 matrix null line identifies r=(Z1/Z3,Z2/Z3) for independent complex normals. A separate circular-normal denominator is independent of Z2, establishing |eta|^2=q V/U for independent Exp(1) variables, CDF z/[q+(1-q)z], and mean Phi(q) by exact integration. The complex ratio for the eigenvalue gives a tail gamma^2/(t^2+gamma^2) and divergent second moment. The q~(b/a)^2 theta^2 expansion yields the exact logarithmic coefficient. The packaged standalone verify.py was run successfully, but is supportive rather than a proof.

value.rationale: A new exact stochastic reliability benchmark shows that the published probabilistic linear-angle accuracy guarantee for a randomized Rayleigh–Ritz eigensolver may coexist with a sharp logarithmic degradation in expected squared-angle and infinite raw-eigenvalue variance, even in a simple well-conditioned Hermitian diagonal example. The complete CDF and exact coefficient quantitatively guide selection of meaningful performance metrics and assessment of refining or oversampling, without claiming those variants are proved.
